Hosted preview. Page links can’t open your PDFs from a web page — a browser won’t let an https page reach files on your disk. To use the ~10,800 links, download the index and open it from the folder with your Traveller rulebooks. Download

Mongoose Traveller 2e — Master Index

Where are your PDFs?

Each page number links into a book. Tell the index where each book actually lives. A path can be a plain filename (same folder as this page), a relative path (books/High Guard.pdf), an absolute file:///… URL, or an https://… URL. Settings are stored in this browser only.

Select all nine at once - filenames are filled in exactly, no typing.

Why you still have to type the folder: browsers never reveal a file's full path to a web page - that is a deliberate security boundary, not something this index can work around. Picking the files gets their names exactly right; the folder is the one thing you set, once.

A link opens the book at the right page (via #page=), at whatever zoom your PDF viewer is set to. It does not scroll to the exact paragraph — browser PDF viewers handle that inconsistently, so the index aims the page and lets you read from the top.
